approach: Two points at equal height on a projectile's path are reached at times symmetric about the time of maximum height, which fixes the initial speed.

steps.text: The two times of equal height are symmetric about the time to reach maximum height.
Use the time to maximum height to find the initial speed, with the projection angle 45°.
steps.equation: t_top = u sin45°/g → 5 = u sin45°/10 → u = 50√2 m/s

steps.text: Find the horizontal component of the velocity, which stays constant through the flight.
Multiply the horizontal speed by the time between the two points to get the horizontal distance.

common_mistakes.text: Using the full time of flight, 10 s (twice t_top), instead of the 6 s gap between the two given points gives 500 m.
